purpose: The three-panel instrument gallery of Figure 12 (section 9): v2 cockpit, dashboard twisted-state viewport, 10 kW winner cartography. One pass, one commit.
head: 47498289e3febbd5855ff586ef31d1c8762802b9
dataset_note: Two panels read no dataset at all. v2 renders the 10 kW canonical system from the tree (params_10kw(), settled at V = 11 m/s). The twisted-state cell renders the same system through the export script's default settle and reads no file. The cartography decodes its ring stack from elite_archive.csv and its title carries the design tag and geometry descriptors only. No panel prints a campaign result. No value in this report is read from a panel.
provenance_note: Each capture names its invocation under `flags`, because one of the three does not print its shipped frame under the renderer's defaults: the cartography's geometry title is set by KTD_WINNER_TITLE=geometry. The twisted-state cell needs its window size fixed, so the column boundaries the crop cuts on hold. A reader who holds the commit, the renderer and the inputs still needs those flags to rebuild the frame. Figure 11's captures directory is tracked from fa91a8e, so both figures' kits carry a renderer in the tree.

print.row_1: v2 + the twisted-state viewport, flush from 0.00 mm
print.row_2: the cartography alone at 85.00 mm, centred from 44.50 mm: a third panel in two 85 mm columns leaves one cell empty
print.raster: 3638 x 2588 px at 531 dpi = 174.02 x 123.80 mm. A 4.00 mm gutter is 83.6 px, so the grid carries 84 px: the plate prints 0.02 mm over the nominal measure and 0.03 mm over the 123.77 mm block

dashboard-v2-head.png.shot: 1780 x 1180 logical units, one frame of a 1.0 s canonical run (50 frames, SAVE_EVERY 500, DT 4e-5)

dashboard-v2-head.png.note: byte-identical to Figure 11's member; reproduced at this commit as the re-stamp control. It is the set's one whole cockpit window

dashboard-twisted-state-head.png.shot: 2696 x 1900 px cut from a 4074 x 1900 whole-window render at px_per_unit 2, device columns 613..3308. The cut lands on the measured ink boundaries, so both inside margins carry no ink and the scene prints every pixel it draws
dashboard-twisted-state-head.png.flags: No flags. figsize=(2037, 950) at px_per_unit 2 fixes the window. The ink boundaries crop-twisted-cell.py cuts on hold. The build_dashboard figsize default is (1600, 950).

The frame shows twist, line tension and ring compression through the dashboard's own colour scales and prints no campaign result. State, printed by the generator: twist 214.71 deg (hub - PTO), T_peak 3099.9 N of 3500 N SWL, omega_hub 9.5 rad/s, electrical power 0.01 kW
